svg.aria-label: Left: average return per episode on the short corridor over 1,000 episodes for REINFORCE with step sizes 2 to the minus 13 and 2 to the minus 12, and REINFORCE with a learned baseline and step size 2 to the minus 9; all approach the optimum of minus 11.66, the baseline version fastest. Right: episode length on CartPole for a linear actor-critic, averaged over three seeds: GAE with lambda 0.95 reaches 500 within about 250 episodes; lambda 1 with a ten times smaller step size gets there more slowly; lambda 0 stalls below 100; lambda 1 and no critic at the large step size collapse to about 9 steps
svg.text: short corridor: learning a stochastic policy
